title: Clinic Rules for Redeeming Included Services
content:
**Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans — redemption rules.**

1. **Plan status.** The plan status is Active when the service is redeemed. The plan record in the clinic's system is the evidence of status, for the plan against which the service is redeemed.
2. **What counts as included.** Included services are the counted services of the plan's schedule of benefits up to their count per term; the plan's core vaccines, as they fall due; sick-pet office visits without limit where the plan includes unlimited office visits; telehealth where the plan includes it; a microchip where the plan includes a microchip; and deworming where the plan includes deworming.
3. **Exam spacing.** Two wellness exams must be at least the plan's spacing interval apart, counted in calendar days: 21 days under the Puppy and Kitten Wellness Plans and 120 days under the Adult Dog, Adult Cat, Senior Dog and Senior Cat Wellness Plans.
4. **Value recorded.** Each redemption records the service's clinic list price on the service date.
5. **No carry-over.** Unused services never carry over into the next term.
6. **Exclusions.** Emergency, after-hours and specialist care are not covered.

A redemption is an included service performed at no charge; each one is recorded as a separate entry for the service, numbered in order within the term. The services used in a term are the redemptions of that term for each service, leaving out any redemption that has been voided.

## Exam spacing — hypothetical dates

"At least" includes the interval itself: an exam exactly 21 or 120 calendar days after the previous wellness exam meets the spacing.

| Plan | Previous wellness exam | Next exam on | Spacing met? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | 10 January | 31 January (21 days later) | Yes |
| Puppy Wellness Plan | 10 January | 30 January (20 days later) | No |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 10 January 2025 | 10 May 2025 (120 days later) | Yes |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 10 January 2025 | 9 May 2025 (119 days later) | No |

## Status at the time of redemption

| Plan status on the service date | Redemption under the plan |
|---|---|
| Active | Permitted, within the counts and the spacing above |
| Past due | Not permitted |
| Expired | Not permitted |
| Cancelled | Not permitted |

## Counting within the term (hypothetical)

A hypothetical Adult Dog Wellness Plan whose term already shows two wellness exam redemptions, neither voided, has used its count of two wellness exams for that term. If one of the two had been voided, the term would show one wellness exam used.
